items.heading: Pabellon Criollo
details: Key ingredients: shredded beef, black beans, rice, plantain
Simmer beef until very tender, then shred it into strands.
Saute the shredded beef with tomato and onion.
Cook black beans and white rice separately.
Plate the beef, beans and rice together with fried sweet plantain.

items.heading: Arepas Venezolanas
details: Key ingredients: corn flour, water, salt, filling of choice
Mix precooked corn flour with warm water and salt into a soft dough.
Shape into flat, round discs.
Cook on a griddle until lightly charred, then finish in the oven.
Split open and fill with cheese, beans or shredded meat.
